import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;

    static class Edge {
        int dest;
        int reverse;
        int capacity;
        int weight;

        Edge(int dest, int reverse, int capacity, int weight) {
            this.dest = dest;
            this.reverse = reverse;
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.weight = weight;
        }
    }

    static List<List<Edge>> adj;
    static int[] seen, ptr, d, pot;
    static int total_nodes;

    static int new_node() {
        adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
        return total_nodes++;
    }

    static void connect(int u, int v, int cap, int cost) {
        adj.get(u).add(new Edge(v, adj.get(v).size(), cap, cost));
        adj.get(v).add(new Edge(u, adj.get(u).size() - 1, 0, -cost));
    }

    static boolean shortest_path(int src, int dst) {
        Arrays.fill(d, INF);
        Arrays.fill(seen, 0);
        PriorityQueue<int[]> heap = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingInt(a -> a[0]));
        d[src] = 0;
        heap.offer(new int[]{0, src});
        while (!heap.isEmpty()) {
            int[] top = heap.poll();
            int du = top[0], u = top[1];
            if (seen[u] != 0) continue;
            seen[u] = 1;
            for (Edge e : adj.get(u)) {
                int v = e.dest;
                int dv = du + pot[u] + e.weight - pot[v];
                if (e.capacity == 0 || seen[v] != 0 || d[v] <= dv) continue;
                d[v] = dv;
                heap.offer(new int[]{dv, v});
            }
        }
        return seen[dst] != 0;
    }

    static boolean bfs_layered(int src, int dst) {
        Arrays.fill(seen, 0);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(src);
        seen[src] = 1;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (Edge e : adj.get(u)) {
                int v = e.dest;
                if (seen[v] != 0 || e.capacity == 0) continue;
                if (d[v] != d[u] + e.weight - pot[v] + pot[u]) continue;
                seen[v] = seen[u] + 1;
                q.offer(v);
            }
        }
        return seen[dst] != 0;
    }

    static int dfs_flow(int u, int dst, int flow) {
        if (u == dst) return flow;
        int pushed = 0;
        for (int i = ptr[u]; i < adj.get(u).size(); ++i) {
            ptr[u] = i;
            Edge e = adj.get(u).get(i);
            int v = e.dest;
            if (e.capacity == 0 || seen[v] != seen[u] + 1) continue;
            if (d[v] != d[u] + e.weight - pot[v] + pot[u]) continue;
            int df = dfs_flow(v, dst, Math.min(e.capacity, flow));
            pushed += df;
            flow -= df;
            e.capacity -= df;
            adj.get(v).get(e.reverse).capacity += df;
            if (flow == 0) break;
        }
        return pushed;
    }

    static int[] solve(int src, int dst, int limit) {
        int total_flow = 0, total_cost = 0;
        Arrays.fill(pot, 0);
        while (shortest_path(src, dst)) {
            int flow = 0;
            while (bfs_layered(src, dst)) {
                Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
                int df = dfs_flow(src, dst, limit);
                limit -= df;
                flow += df;
                if (limit == 0) break;
            }
            total_flow += flow;
            total_cost += (d[dst] + pot[dst]) * flow;
            for (int i = 0; i < total_nodes; ++i)
                pot[i] += d[i];
            if (limit == 0) break;
        }
        return new int[]{total_flow, total_cost};
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d_val = sc.nextInt();
        int layers = Math.max(n, k) * 2;
        adj = new ArrayList<>();
        total_nodes = 0;
        new_node();
        int source = new_node();
        int sink = new_node();
        for (int j = 0; j < k; ++j) {
            int a = sc.nextInt();
            --a;
            connect(source, a, 1, 0);
        }
        for (int z = 1; z <= m; ++z) {
            int u = sc.nextInt();
            int v = sc.nextInt();
            --u; --v;
            for (int i = 0; i + 1 < layers; ++i) {
                int u1 = u + i * n, v1 = v + (i + 1) * n;
                int u2 = u + (i + 1) * n, v2 = v + i * n;
                for (int j = 0; j < k; ++j) {
                    connect(u1, v1, 1, c + d_val * (2 * j + 1));
                    connect(v2, u2, 1, c + d_val * (2 * j + 1));
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i + 1 < layers; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                int u = j + i * n, v = j + (i + 1) * n;
                connect(u, v, INF, c);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < layers; ++i)
            connect(i * n, sink, INF, 0);
        d = new int[total_nodes];
        seen = new int[total_nodes];
        ptr = new int[total_nodes];
        pot = new int[total_nodes];
        System.out.println(solve(source, sink, INF)[1]);
    }
}
